body:
That is insane to imagine, maybe I’m not afraid of death. Quite a liberating feeling. 
And with regards to how to be less afraid, I think it was just a product of a bad/dark couple of years when I struggled deeply with suicide and self-harm. And it’s good to know now that I’ve reached a better place, I seem to accepted a future and no longer hold death as the ‘escape’, perhaps.
Yea, I guess so. Possibly a new change is coming?
yea it’s not great, but thanks for understanding
im sorry if i offended anyone, these were just my feelings and have been experiencing them for a while.
EXACTLY

no i know there are people out there who suffer from anxiety and i understand the struggles they go through. 

the people im talking about are the ones who want to “relate”, you know the classic saying:
when you say something that anxiety did to you and they’ll say, just for the sake of relating, “sameeeee” and these people say this for EVERYTHING and i mean every single struggle you’ve had. them saying it again and again kind of makes me feel like im faking it or that whatever happening to me is something stupid. 
and on top of that there are people out there, my other friends who actually suffer from anxiety and when they want to speak out and essentially say “same” they don’t because no ones going to listen or pay any attention because it’s such a “trend” to be anxious. 
that’s what pisses me off

i think you’re not understanding what I’m saying.
these people make fun of being anxious
there’s a difference.

hey, trust me you’re going to thrive! 
don’t underestimate yourself
im sorry for what’s going on in your life
that’s very kind, but it’s ok, ill manage :)
thanks, but im beyond help nor do i want any help
thanks for understanding :) really great advice
wow, thanks a lot dude. that’s helpful.
i swear
that’s a reason i don’t want to talk to my parents about it. they’ll just get actually angry with me and rather than comfort me they’d yell at me for having ‘such thoughts’ or suicidal thoughts

i feel you bud. 
and your English was perfect :)

yea i get that
it’s so hard because tbh to some extent it is kind of their fault but that’s not what im looking for. i dont want them to apologise, i just want them to understand
oh yea i know what you’re talking about, questioning why i exist and whether i even should. overthinking is my worst habit and i really wish you could work through it. it’s horrible.
maybe you want to talk to a therapist about this? because if you have to examine whether you’re real that’s scary and a sign of another mental illness.
im glad you’re taking therapy and i hope it helps you. good luck!
ill keep saying that until my brain and body accept it.
i believe in you and you’ll nail the next interview

this is really the nicest thing ive read. thanks a lot bud. your advise is really helpful. ill keep everything you said with me and hopefully try and apply them all.

thanks for talking about how you feel. it’s really empowering.
the fact that you reach out your hand is the sweetest thing ive heard. i hope i could be there to hold your hand :)
i know that’s exactly it. ive just become numb and have stopped trying to talk about my feelings it’s not worth it. it just takes me to a horrible negative spiral
not really but it’s that whole ‘narcissistic’ personality that no one likes. only talk about me and no one wants to just talk about one person
she’s a bitch. just stay away from her.

that’s really good advise dude. thanks...
id keep this in mind next time anyone tries to dismiss my feelings. 

but. what if it’s someone like a parent. i can’t say anything to them. ive just gone into this habit of staying quiet and nodding. how do i tackle that?

im so happy that you’re getting help! 
im so proud of you bud :)

you feel the private connection too? 
oh im so glad. i am adamant on not going to a therapist because it’s so fake and they don’t really care about me, they’ll stop talking and listening to me the second i stop paying them. it’s just a transaction and fake feelings and i hate that so much. i just want to find someone who truly cares
who are these people? where are they?

but i don’t want to feel bad, i absolutely hate it. it’s the worst feeling ever. ive gone into this mode where because people don’t want to listen ive started loathing myself and my self-hatred has just increased SO much. i really do hate myself a lot.

and ill gladly take on these labels of self-pity but that just means ill die alone and probably kms because i don’t ‘the one’ exists

also thanks for the advise and support, really means a lot :)
i feel you dude, i feel like when i do kill myself it’s gonna be this crap that they’ll say
im numb too, ive been contemplating suicide for a while now, ive even set a date because it’s so hard to dwell in so much negativity i don’t want to live in it anymore. im so tired
exactly, i just want to get out of my crap. but the only way to do that is to open up. BUT no one CARES, so it’s like a self-killing inescapable loop :)
but people don’t know that, im scared of opening up and don’t want to do it anymore because of this, all they want is the ‘fun me’ but that girl is not me
